 At Jabalpur

sentences.text: Ms. Savita Choudhary - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri G.S. Thakur - Government Advocate for respondent/S
1.
Heard on admission.
2. Appeal is admitted for hearing.
3. Appellant has filed I.A. No.23466/2023 an application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence.

4 . Appellant has been convicted under Sections 366, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for five years, ten years and ten years with fine of Rs.2000/-, Rs.5000/- and Rs.5000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant has filed an affidavit showing that appellant is taking care of minor daughter born to them.
Prosecutrix is married to some other person and living separately.
There is no likelihood of hearing of appeal in near future.
Trial Court has committed an error in convicting the appellant.
6. Learned Government Advocate opposed the application for suspension of sentence.

7. Heard the counsel for the parties.
8.
Considering the aforesaid and fixed short term of sentence, I.A. No.23466/2023 for suspension of sentence is allowed.

9. It is hereby directed that the custodial sentence awarded to the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and on deposit of fine amount, if already not deposited, he shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety bond of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his Shivnarayan Jatav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171075993/
1 appearance before the Registry of this Court on 11.07.2024 and on other dates as may be fixed in this regard till final disposal of this appeal.
